entry.title: New: Stata-AI-Skill
entry.summary: Run Stata through DeepSeek Harness: the native Stata AI Skill service auto-starts with DSH (macOS/Windows binaries bundled), so you can run regressions, do-files and econometrics workflows with no manual setup.
